svg.text: A kit from declaration to proof
Declared in code, planned, installed, then checked
A Kit subclass in ws_host/kits lists apt packages, downloads, links and checks
kitrun.plan resolves what is missing, with no change to the machine
kitrun.install: apt through sudo, then each download verified and unpacked, then links in
kit_report runs each check: the program is there, then it does a small real job
